zh: 有人在我背后戳了一下。
en: Someone {poked|prodded|jabbed} me in the back.

zh: 她看到账单的时候皱起了眉头。
en: She {frowned} when she saw the bill.

zh: 听到价格的时候，他眼睛都没眨一下。
en: He didn't even {blink} when he heard the price.

zh: 他松了松领带。
en: He {loosened} his tie.

zh: 她把衬衫上的面包屑弹掉了。
en: She {flicked|brushed} the crumbs off her shirt.

zh: 他弯下腰去捡钥匙。
en: He {stooped|bent} to pick up his keys.

zh: 演出结束时，演员们向观众鞠躬。
en: At the end of the show, the cast {bowed} to the audience.

zh: 他猛地一把拉开了门。
en: He {yanked|pulled} the door open.

zh: 她每天早上给女儿编辫子。
en: She {braids|plaits} her daughter's hair every morning.

zh: 他靠在墙上等着。
en: He {leaned|leant} against the wall and waited.

zh: 我当时悄悄地下楼，生怕吵醒别人。
en: I was {creeping|sneaking|tiptoeing} downstairs so I wouldn't wake anyone.

zh: 他喝醉了，摇摇晃晃地走回了家。
en: He was drunk and {staggered|stumbled} home.

zh: 搬重物的时候要弯膝盖。
en: {Bend} your knees when you lift something heavy.

zh: 她皱着眉头瞪了我一眼。
en: She {scowled|frowned|glared} at me.

zh: 他把那封信揉成了一团。
en: He {crumpled|scrunched} the letter into a ball.

zh: 他把那个很重的箱子拖到了门口。
en: He {dragged|hauled} the heavy box to the door.

zh: 遇到特别的场合，她会把头发卷一下。
en: She {curls} her hair for special occasions.

zh: 他揉了揉眼睛。
en: He {rubbed} his eyes.

zh: 他掐了自己一下，确认不是在做梦。
en: He {pinched} himself to make sure he wasn't dreaming.

zh: 拍照前把头发梳一下。
en: {Comb|Brush} your hair before the photo.

zh: 有人在人群里推了我一把。
en: Someone {shoved|pushed} me in the crowd.

zh: 她瞥了一眼手表。
en: She {glanced} at her watch.

zh: 她指了指地图上的一个地方。
en: She {pointed} to a spot on the map.

zh: 他只是耸了耸肩，什么也没说。
en: He just {shrugged} and said nothing.

zh: 她每两个月染一次头发。
en: She {colours|colors|dyes} her hair every two months.

zh: 她招手示意我过去。
en: She {beckoned|waved|motioned|signalled|signaled|gestured} me over.

zh: 他今天早上刮了胡子。
en: He {shaved} this morning before work.

zh: 我只需要修一下胡子。
en: I just need to {trim} my beard.

zh: 他蹲下来系鞋带。
en: He {crouched|squatted|bent} down to tie his shoelace.

zh: 先解开鞋带再脱鞋。
en: {Untie} your laces before you take your shoes off.

zh: 我每隔一天用洗发水洗一次头。
en: I {shampoo|wash} my hair every second day.

zh: 阳光太刺眼，我只好眯起眼睛。
en: The sun was so bright that I had to {squint}.

zh: 我不小心踩到了一块乐高。
en: I {stepped|trod} on a piece of Lego.

zh: 睡觉前要刷牙。
en: {Brush|Clean} your teeth before bed.

zh: 你能帮我拉一下裙子的拉链吗？
en: Can you {zip} my dress for me?

zh: 我被一根电线绊倒了。
en: I {tripped} over a cable.

zh: 别动来动去的，坐好！
en: Stop {fidgeting} and sit still!
